title: Camera Works
description: A badly made library of cameras for datapacks :/
body:
# Camera

![List of files in "Camera"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/393c65e870ab1f3e5d6dc9c87e2d47e881f7cde4.png)

The files in this directory are designed to be edited for customization.

# How It Works
This system operates using armor stands and supports up to 10 players.

It summons an armor stand at the location of each player, up to a maximum of 10.
The system "caches" the position of these players.
It then teleports the players into spectator mode, then the players return to their original position, making for a sort of camera system.

# Limitations
While functional, the system is not yet optimized. There are areas for improvement to make it more efficient and user-friendly.
(It kinda sucks lol)

# Commands

### /function camera:start
This command starts the camera in that position.

### /function camera:end
This command stops the camera and teleports the players back.
